name: Runemaster audit: Leyline Disturbance raid-hastes allies 10% and cuts stun duration on self 20% (#3741)
contract: Leyline Disturbance 560540 effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) carrying SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE (192), EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = +10, RadiusIndex 287 (~100yd) - the same native raid-aura delivery proven for the Barbarian audit's raid passives. Effect 1 is a self-targeted SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD (232), EffectMiscValue 12 (MECHANIC_STUN), EffectBasePoints -21 + 1 = -20%, implemented in Unit::CalculateSpellDuration. Cheap Shot (1833) has Mechanic 12 and a 4000ms base duration (SpellDuration 35), long enough to observe a clean 20% cut. Verification notes: (1) WorldSession::HandleCancelAuraOpcode (SpellHandler.cpp:605) refuses to remove a non-positive aura ('don't allow remove non positive spells') - Cheap Shot's stun is harmful, so the client-style cancel_aura action silently no-ops on it; this uses set_aura with stacks 0 (Unit::RemoveAurasDueToSpell, no positivity check) to clear the stun between the two casts instead. (2) Unit::ApplyDiminishingToDuration (Unit.cpp:12615) applies stun-category Diminishing Returns to any player target independently of Leyline Disturbance - Unit::GetDiminishing (Unit.cpp:12575) only resets the DR level to 1 (full duration) once the prior stack is gone AND more than 15000ms have passed since the last hit; recasting Cheap Shot right after clearing it would still land at DR level 2 (an extra native 50% cut on top of Leyline's own -20%), so this waits over 15s between the two casts to isolate Leyline's own mechanism. (3) aura_duration_ms reads the aura's live remaining duration, which decays every real millisecond, so the post-cast reading is taken as an immediate snapshot (no assert-with-within_ms polling window) to avoid comparing a stale, partially-decayed value.

steps.label: Baseline Cheap Shot duration on self
Clear the stun (cancel_aura refuses non-positive auras)
Leyline Disturbance reaches the party member
Let stun-category Diminishing Returns fully reset (>15s)
Cheap Shot duration on self is cut ~20% (0.75-0.85)
